coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 10 of 17 ground-truth variable items (59%): consistent data splits, sequence length, forecast horizon, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, RevIN usage, data normalization, MSE, and MAE. Relevant variables were extracted from the narrative and code.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW rather than Adam, 50 rather than 30 epochs, and batch sizes of 32/64 rather than 256. Does not specify the required single RTX 4090 with 24GB memory, instead discussing a generic 16GB GPU. Omits synthetic-data generation parameters and visualization outputs. Tensor folding and phase indexing do not clearly specify the required method for generating time-aligned cycle indices.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to identify the expected deliverable: a trained CycleNet model capable of accurate forecasting, with visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
